title: Samaṇabrāhmaṇa (2)
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Catasso imā bhikkhave dhātuyo || || Katamā catasso || || Pathavīdhātu || āpodhātu || tejodhātu || vāyodhātu || || 3 Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātunaṃ samudayañ ca atthagamān ca assādañ ca ādīnavañ ca nissaraṇañ ca yathābhūtaṃ na pajānantī ti vitthāretabbam || 4 Pajānanti || pe|| sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || || Navamaṃ || ||
